target_structure: aspect marker le in daily routines
prompt_vi: Nói bằng tiếng Trung: I ate dinner.
correction_note: Use short action-result routines and compare verb-final 了 with sentence-final 了.

prompt_vi: Nói bằng tiếng Trung: two cups of tea.
correction_note: Teach object-specific classifier chunks such as 一杯茶, 两本书, 三张票.

prompt_vi: Nói bằng tiếng Trung: I found the ticket.
correction_note: Contrast 找票 and 找到票了; ask learners to say whether the action reached a result.

prompt_vi: Viết pinyin có thanh điệu cho 马.
correction_note: Use minimal tone pairs and require tone marks in written rehearsal.

prompt_vi: Nói bằng tiếng Trung: I study Chinese at school.
error_feature: place phrase inserted between verb and object
correction_note: Practice subject + time/place + verb phrase frames before open production.
